1	import DeGiorgi.Common
2	
3	/-!
4	# Chapter 02: Oscillation BMO Prelude
5	
6	This module packages the BMO definitions, basic John-Nirenberg geometry, and
7	preliminary iteration and covering lemmas.
8	-/
9	
10	noncomputable section
11	
12	open MeasureTheory Metric Filter Set
13	open scoped ENNReal NNReal Topology
14	
15	namespace DeGiorgi
16	
17	variable {d : ℕ}
18	
19	local notation "E" => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
20	
21	/-! ## Constants -/
22	
23	/-- The John-Nirenberg constant. -/
24	noncomputable def C_JN (d : ℕ) : ℝ :=
25	  16 * 36 ^ d
26	
27	theorem C_JN_pos (d : ℕ) : 0 < C_JN d := by unfold C_JN; positivity
28	
29	lemma five_pow_half_factor (d : ℕ) :
30	    (5 : ℝ) ^ d * (1 / (2 * 5 ^ d)) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
31	  have h : (5 : ℝ) ^ d ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)
32	  field_simp
33	noncomputable def C_iter : ℝ := 1024
34	
35	theorem C_iter_pos : 0 < C_iter := by unfold C_iter; norm_num
36	
37	/-! ## BMO -/
38	
39	/-- The BMO seminorm on a set `U`. -/
40	noncomputable def bmoNorm (u : E → ℝ) (U : Set E) : ℝ :=
41	  sSup {t : ℝ | ∃ (x₀ : E) (r : ℝ), 0 < r ∧
42	    Metric.closedBall x₀ r ⊆ U ∧
43	    t = (⨍ x in Metric.ball x₀ r, ‖u x - ⨍ y in Metric.ball x₀ r, u y ∂volume‖ ∂volume)}
44	
45	/-! ## John-Nirenberg Geometry -/
46	
47	/-- Balls inside a fixed ambient ball, used in the Calderón-Zygmund selection behind the
48	John-Nirenberg argument. -/
49	structure JNBall (x₀ : E) (R : ℝ) where
50	  center : E
51	  radius : ℝ
52	  radius_pos : 0 < radius
53	  radius_le : radius ≤ R
54	  center_mem : center ∈ Metric.ball x₀ R
55	
56	namespace JNBall
57	
58	def carrier {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : JNBall x₀ R) : Set E :=
59	  Metric.ball b.center b.radius
60	
61	def fivefold {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : JNBall x₀ R) : Set E :=
62	  Metric.ball b.center (5 * b.radius)
63	
64	lemma measurableSet_carrier {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : JNBall x₀ R) :
65	    MeasurableSet b.carrier := measurableSet_ball
66	
67	lemma measurableSet_fivefold {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : JNBall x₀ R) :
68	    MeasurableSet b.fivefold := measurableSet_ball
69	
70	lemma carrier_nonempty {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : JNBall x₀ R) :
71	    b.carrier.Nonempty := nonempty_ball.2 b.radius_pos
72	
73	end JNBall
74	
75	lemma ball_subset_fivefold_of_inter_nonempty
76	    {a c d : E} {ρ r s : ℝ}
77	    (hsub : Metric.ball a ρ ⊆ Metric.ball c r)
78	    (hint : (Metric.ball c r ∩ Metric.ball d s).Nonempty)
79	    (hrad : r ≤ 2 * s) :
80	    Metric.ball a ρ ⊆ Metric.ball d (5 * s) := by
81	  intro x hx
82	  have hxc := Metric.mem_ball.mp (hsub hx)
83	  obtain ⟨z, hzc, hzd⟩ := hint
84	  rw [Metric.mem_ball]
85	  simp only [Metric.mem_ball] at hzc hzd
86	  linarith [dist_triangle x c d, dist_triangle c z d, dist_comm z c]
87	lemma john_nirenberg_iteration_decay_iterate
88	    {E_lam : ℝ → Set E} {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) {θ : ℝ}
89	    (h_decay : ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → volume (E_lam (lam + A)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal θ * volume (E_lam lam))
90	    (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (n : ℕ) :
91	    volume (E_lam (lam + n * A)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal θ ^ n * volume (E_lam lam) := by
92	  induction n with
93	  | zero => simp
94	  | succ n ih =>
95	    have key : lam + (↑(n + 1)) * A = (lam + ↑n * A) + A := by push_cast; ring
96	    rw [key]
97	    calc volume (E_lam (lam + ↑n * A + A))
98	        ≤ ENNReal.ofReal θ * volume (E_lam (lam + ↑n * A)) :=
99	          h_decay _ (by positivity)
100	      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal θ * (ENNReal.ofReal θ ^ n * volume (E_lam lam)) :=
101	          mul_le_mul_right ih _
102	      _ = ENNReal.ofReal θ ^ (n + 1) * volume (E_lam lam) := by ring
103	lemma john_nirenberg_iteration_ofReal_pow (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (n : ℕ) :
104	    ENNReal.ofReal θ ^ n = ENNReal.ofReal (θ ^ n) := by
105	  induction n with
106	  | zero => simp
107	  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ, ih, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (pow_nonneg hθ n), pow_succ]
108	lemma john_nirenberg_iteration_rpow_bound (θ lam A : ℝ) (hθ_pos : 0 < θ) (hθ_lt : θ < 1)
109	    (k : ℕ) (hk : (↑k : ℝ) ≥ lam / A - 1) :
110	    ENNReal.ofReal (θ ^ k) ≤
111	      ENNReal.ofReal (1 / θ) * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-lam * (-Real.log θ / A))) := by sorry
112	theorem john_nirenberg_iteration
113	    {B : Set E} {E_lam : ℝ → Set E}
114	    (_hB : MeasurableSet B) (_hB_fin : volume B ≠ ⊤)
115	    (hE_sub : ∀ lam, E_lam lam ⊆ B)
116	    (_hE_meas : ∀ lam, MeasurableSet (E_lam lam))
117	    (_hE_anti : ∀ lam₁ lam₂, lam₁ ≤ lam₂ → E_lam lam₂ ⊆ E_lam lam₁)
118	    {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A)
119	    {θ : ℝ} (hθ_pos : 0 < θ) (hθ_lt : θ < 1)
120	    (h_decay : ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → volume (E_lam (lam + A)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal θ * volume (E_lam lam)) :
121	    ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam →
122	      volume (E_lam lam) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 / θ) * volume B *
123	        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-lam * (-Real.log θ / A))) := by sorry
124	theorem john_nirenberg
125	    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {r t A θ : ℝ}
126	    (_hr : 0 < r) (ht : 0 < t) (hu_meas : Measurable u)
127	    (hA : 0 < A) (hθ_pos : 0 < θ) (hθ_lt : θ < 1)
128	    (h_decay : ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam →
129	      volume ({x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r |
130	        ‖u x - ⨍ y in Metric.ball x₀ r, u y ∂volume‖ > lam + A}) ≤
131	        ENNReal.ofReal θ *
132	          volume ({x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r |
133	            ‖u x - ⨍ y in Metric.ball x₀ r, u y ∂volume‖ > lam})) :
134	    volume ({x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r |
135	      ‖u x - ⨍ y in Metric.ball x₀ r, u y ∂volume‖ > t}) ≤
136	    ENNReal.ofReal (1 / θ) * volume (Metric.ball x₀ r) *
137	      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-t * (-Real.log θ / A))) := by sorry
138	theorem indicator_bmo_bound
139	    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {r M : ℝ}
140	    (hu_bmo : ∀ (z : E) (s : ℝ), 0 < s → Metric.closedBall z s ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ r →
141	      (⨍ x in Metric.ball z s, ‖u x - ⨍ y in Metric.ball z s, u y ∂volume‖ ∂volume) ≤ M)
142	    (z : E) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (hzs : Metric.closedBall z s ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ r) :
143	    (⨍ x in Metric.ball z s,
144	      ‖(Metric.ball x₀ r).indicator u x -
145	        ⨍ y in Metric.ball z s, (Metric.ball x₀ r).indicator u y ∂volume‖ ∂volume) ≤
146	      M := by sorry
147	
148	/-! ## Simple Iteration Lemma (AKM, Lemma C.6) -/
149	
150	/-- **Simple Iteration Lemma** (AKM, Appendix C, Lemma C.6, specialized to ξ = 2).
151	
152	Suppose `ρ : ℝ → ℝ` satisfies:
153	1. `ρ ≥ 0` on `[1/2, 1)`,
154	2. `sup_{t ∈ [1/2,1)} (1-t)² ρ(t) < ∞` (finiteness of weighted supremum),
155	3. For all `1/2 ≤ s < t < 1`: `ρ(s) ≤ (1/2) ρ(t) + A_iter · (t - s)⁻²`
156	
157	Then `ρ(1/2) ≤ C_iter · A_iter`.
158	
159	**Proof sketch** (following AKM):
160	- Let `M = sup_{t ∈ [1/2,1)} (1-t)² ρ(t)`.
161	- Choose `δ = 1 - (2/3)^{1/2}` and set `t = 1 - (1-δ)(1-s)` in hypothesis (3).
162	- Multiply by `(1-s)²` to get: `(1-s)² ρ(s) ≤ (3/4) · (1-t)² ρ(t) + δ⁻² · A_iter`.
163	- Take supremum: `M ≤ (3/4) M + δ⁻² · A_iter`, hence `M ≤ 4 δ⁻² A_iter`.
164	- Evaluate at `s = 1/2`: `ρ(1/2) ≤ 2² · M ≤ 4 · 4 · δ⁻² · A_iter ≤ C_iter · A_iter`.
165	-/
166	theorem simple_iteration_lemma
167	    {ρ : ℝ → ℝ} {A_iter : ℝ}
168	    (hA_iter : 0 ≤ A_iter)
169	    (hρ_nonneg : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 / 2 ≤ t → t < 1 → 0 ≤ ρ t)
170	    (hρ_bdd : ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ t : ℝ, 1 / 2 ≤ t → t < 1 → (1 - t) ^ 2 * ρ t ≤ M)
171	    (hρ_contract : ∀ s t : ℝ, 1 / 2 ≤ s → s < t → t < 1 →
172	      ρ s ≤ 1 / 2 * ρ t + A_iter * (t - s) ⁻¹ ^ 2) :
173	    ρ (1 / 2) ≤ C_iter * A_iter := by sorry
174	
175	/-! ## Vitali Covering Lemma -/
176	
177	/-- Vitali covering lemma (5r-covering): from any family of balls, one can extract a
178	disjoint subfamily such that the 5× enlargements cover the union, and every original
179	ball meets a selected ball of at least half its radius. -/
180	theorem vitali_covering_lemma
181	    {ι : Type*} {x : ι → E} {r : ι → ℝ}
182	    (hr_pos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
183	    (hr_bdd : BddAbove (Set.range r))
184	    (hfin : (⋃ i, Metric.ball (x i) (r i)).Nonempty) :
185	    ∃ S : Set ι, S.Countable ∧
186	      (∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j ∈ S, i ≠ j →
187	        Disjoint (Metric.ball (x i) (r i)) (Metric.ball (x j) (r j))) ∧
188	      (∀ i, ∃ j ∈ S,
189	        (Metric.ball (x i) (r i) ∩ Metric.ball (x j) (r j)).Nonempty ∧ r i ≤ 2 * r j) ∧
190	      (⋃ i, Metric.ball (x i) (r i)) ⊆ ⋃ i ∈ S, Metric.ball (x i) (5 * r i) := by sorry
191	
192	
193	lemma volumeReal_ball_eq [NeZero d] (x : E) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
194	    volume.real (Metric.ball x r) = r ^ d * volume.real (Metric.ball (0 : E) 1) := by
195	  simp only [Measure.real_def]
196	  rw [Measure.addHaar_ball _ _ hr.le, finrank_euclideanSpace, Fintype.card_fin,

This module packages the BMO definitions, basic John-Nirenberg geometry, and
preliminary iteration and covering lemmas.
-/

noncomputable section

open MeasureTheory Metric Filter Set
open scoped ENNReal NNReal Topology

namespace DeGiorgi

variable {d : ℕ}

local notation "E" => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)

/-! ## Constants -/

/-- The John-Nirenberg constant. -/
noncomputable def C_JN (d : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  16 * 36 ^ d

theorem C_JN_pos (d : ℕ) : 0 < C_JN d := by unfold C_JN; positivity

lemma five_pow_half_factor (d : ℕ) :
    (5 : ℝ) ^ d * (1 / (2 * 5 ^ d)) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
  have h : (5 : ℝ) ^ d ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)
  field_simp
noncomputable def C_iter : ℝ := 1024

theorem C_iter_pos : 0 < C_iter := by unfold C_iter; norm_num

/-! ## BMO -/

/-- The BMO seminorm on a set `U`. -/
noncomputable def bmoNorm (u : E → ℝ) (U : Set E) : ℝ :=
  sSup {t : ℝ | ∃ (x₀ : E) (r : ℝ), 0 < r ∧
    Metric.closedBall x₀ r ⊆ U ∧
    t = (⨍ x in Metric.ball x₀ r, ‖u x - ⨍ y in Metric.ball x₀ r, u y ∂volume‖ ∂volume)}

/-! ## John-Nirenberg Geometry -/

/-- Balls inside a fixed ambient ball, used in the Calderón-Zygmund selection behind the
John-Nirenberg argument. -/
structure JNBall (x₀ : E) (R : ℝ) where
  center : E
  radius : ℝ
  radius_pos : 0 < radius
  radius_le : radius ≤ R
  center_mem : center ∈ Metric.ball x₀ R

namespace JNBall

def carrier {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : JNBall x₀ R) : Set E :=
  Metric.ball b.center b.radius

def fivefold {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : JNBall x₀ R) : Set E :=
  Metric.ball b.center (5 * b.radius)

lemma measurableSet_carrier {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : JNBall x₀ R) :
    MeasurableSet b.carrier := measurableSet_ball

lemma measurableSet_fivefold {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : JNBall x₀ R) :
    MeasurableSet b.fivefold := measurableSet_ball

lemma carrier_nonempty {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : JNBall x₀ R) :
    b.carrier.Nonempty := nonempty_ball.2 b.radius_pos

end JNBall

lemma ball_subset_fivefold_of_inter_nonempty
    {a c d : E} {ρ r s : ℝ}
    (hsub : Metric.ball a ρ ⊆ Metric.ball c r)
    (hint : (Metric.ball c r ∩ Metric.ball d s).Nonempty)
    (hrad : r ≤ 2 * s) :
    Metric.ball a ρ ⊆ Metric.ball d (5 * s) := by
  intro x hx
  have hxc := Metric.mem_ball.mp (hsub hx)
  obtain ⟨z, hzc, hzd⟩ := hint
  rw [Metric.mem_ball]
  simp only [Metric.mem_ball] at hzc hzd

    {E_lam : ℝ → Set E} {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) {θ : ℝ}
    (h_decay : ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → volume (E_lam (lam + A)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal θ * volume (E_lam lam))

    volume (E_lam (lam + n * A)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal θ ^ n * volume (E_lam lam) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have key : lam + (↑(n + 1)) * A = (lam + ↑n * A) + A := by push_cast; ring
    rw [key]
    calc volume (E_lam (lam + ↑n * A + A))
        ≤ ENNReal.ofReal θ * volume (E_lam (lam + ↑n * A)) :=
          h_decay _ (by positivity)

          mul_le_mul_right ih _
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal θ ^ (n + 1) * volume (E_lam lam) := by ring

    ENNReal.ofReal θ ^ n = ENNReal.ofReal (θ ^ n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ, ih, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (pow_nonneg hθ n), pow_succ]

    ENNReal.ofReal (θ ^ k) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (1 / θ) * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-lam * (-Real.log θ / A))) := by sorry

    (_hB : MeasurableSet B) (_hB_fin : volume B ≠ ⊤)

    (_hE_meas : ∀ lam, MeasurableSet (E_lam lam))
    (_hE_anti : ∀ lam₁ lam₂, lam₁ ≤ lam₂ → E_lam lam₂ ⊆ E_lam lam₁)
    {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A)
    {θ : ℝ} (hθ_pos : 0 < θ) (hθ_lt : θ < 1)
    (h_decay : ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → volume (E_lam (lam + A)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal θ * volume (E_lam lam)) :

    (_hr : 0 < r) (ht : 0 < t) (hu_meas : Measurable u)
    (hA : 0 < A) (hθ_pos : 0 < θ) (hθ_lt : θ < 1)
    (h_decay : ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam →
      volume ({x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r |
        ‖u x - ⨍ y in Metric.ball x₀ r, u y ∂volume‖ > lam + A}) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal θ *

            ‖u x - ⨍ y in Metric.ball x₀ r, u y ∂volume‖ > lam})) :
    volume ({x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r |
      ‖u x - ⨍ y in Metric.ball x₀ r, u y ∂volume‖ > t}) ≤
    ENNReal.ofReal (1 / θ) * volume (Metric.ball x₀ r) *
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-t * (-Real.log θ / A))) := by sorry
theorem indicator_bmo_bound
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {r M : ℝ}
    (hu_bmo : ∀ (z : E) (s : ℝ), 0 < s → Metric.closedBall z s ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ r →
      (⨍ x in Metric.ball z s, ‖u x - ⨍ y in Metric.ball z s, u y ∂volume‖ ∂volume) ≤ M)
    (z : E) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (hzs : Metric.closedBall z s ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ r) :

      ‖(Metric.ball x₀ r).indicator u x -
        ⨍ y in Metric.ball z s, (Metric.ball x₀ r).indicator u y ∂volume‖ ∂volume) ≤
      M := by sorry

/-! ## Simple Iteration Lemma (AKM, Lemma C.6) -/

/-- **Simple Iteration Lemma** (AKM, Appendix C, Lemma C.6, specialized to ξ = 2).

Suppose `ρ : ℝ → ℝ` satisfies:
1. `ρ ≥ 0` on `[1/2, 1)`,
2. `sup_{t ∈ [1/2,1)} (1-t)² ρ(t) < ∞` (finiteness of weighted supremum),
3. For all `1/2 ≤ s < t < 1`: `ρ(s) ≤ (1/2) ρ(t) + A_iter · (t - s)⁻²`

Then `ρ(1/2) ≤ C_iter · A_iter`.

- Let `M = sup_{t ∈ [1/2,1)} (1-t)² ρ(t)`.
- Choose `δ = 1 - (2/3)^{1/2}` and set `t = 1 - (1-δ)(1-s)` in hypothesis (3).
- Multiply by `(1-s)²` to get: `(1-s)² ρ(s) ≤ (3/4) · (1-t)² ρ(t) + δ⁻² · A_iter`.
- Take supremum: `M ≤ (3/4) M + δ⁻² · A_iter`, hence `M ≤ 4 δ⁻² A_iter`.
- Evaluate at `s = 1/2`: `ρ(1/2) ≤ 2² · M ≤ 4 · 4 · δ⁻² · A_iter ≤ C_iter · A_iter`.
-/
theorem simple_iteration_lemma
    {ρ : ℝ → ℝ} {A_iter : ℝ}
    (hA_iter : 0 ≤ A_iter)
    (hρ_nonneg : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 / 2 ≤ t → t < 1 → 0 ≤ ρ t)
    (hρ_bdd : ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ t : ℝ, 1 / 2 ≤ t → t < 1 → (1 - t) ^ 2 * ρ t ≤ M)
    (hρ_contract : ∀ s t : ℝ, 1 / 2 ≤ s → s < t → t < 1 →
      ρ s ≤ 1 / 2 * ρ t + A_iter * (t - s) ⁻¹ ^ 2) :
    ρ (1 / 2) ≤ C_iter * A_iter := by sorry

/-! ## Vitali Covering Lemma -/

/-- Vitali covering lemma (5r-covering): from any family of balls, one can extract a
disjoint subfamily such that the 5× enlargements cover the union, and every original
ball meets a selected ball of at least half its radius. -/
theorem vitali_covering_lemma
    {ι : Type*} {x : ι → E} {r : ι → ℝ}
    (hr_pos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hr_bdd : BddAbove (Set.range r))
    (hfin : (⋃ i, Metric.ball (x i) (r i)).Nonempty) :
    ∃ S : Set ι, S.Countable ∧
      (∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j ∈ S, i ≠ j →
        Disjoint (Metric.ball (x i) (r i)) (Metric.ball (x j) (r j))) ∧
      (∀ i, ∃ j ∈ S,
        (Metric.ball (x i) (r i) ∩ Metric.ball (x j) (r j)).Nonempty ∧ r i ≤ 2 * r j) ∧
      (⋃ i, Metric.ball (x i) (r i)) ⊆ ⋃ i ∈ S, Metric.ball (x i) (5 * r i) := by sorry


lemma volumeReal_ball_eq [NeZero d] (x : E) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    volume.real (Metric.ball x r) = r ^ d * volume.real (Metric.ball (0 : E) 1) := by
  simp only [Measure.real_def]
  rw [Measure.addHaar_ball _ _ hr.le, finrank_euclideanSpace, Fintype.card_fin,

    volume.real (Metric.ball x r) = (2 : ℝ) ^ d * volume.real (Metric.ball x (r / 2)) := by sorry

lemma JNBall.volumeReal_fivefold [NeZero d] {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : JNBall x₀ R) :
    volume.real b.fivefold = (5 : ℝ) ^ d * volume.real b.carrier := by
  simp only [JNBall.fivefold, JNBall.carrier]
  have h5 : (0 : ℝ) < 5 * b.radius := mul_pos (by norm_num) b.radius_pos
  rw [volumeReal_ball_eq _ h5, volumeReal_ball_eq _ b.radius_pos]
  have : (5 * b.radius) ^ d = 5 ^ d * b.radius ^ d := mul_pow 5 b.radius d
  rw [this]; ring

lemma JNBall.volume_fivefold [NeZero d] {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : JNBall x₀ R) :
    volume b.fivefold = ENNReal.ofReal ((5 : ℝ) ^ d) * volume b.carrier := by sorry

end DeGiorgi

  have h : (5 : ℝ) ^ d ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)

  sSup {t : ℝ | ∃ (x₀ : E) (r : ℝ), 0 < r ∧
    Metric.closedBall x₀ r ⊆ U ∧
    t = (⨍ x in Metric.ball x₀ r, ‖u x - ⨍ y in Metric.ball x₀ r, u y ∂volume‖ ∂volume)}

  center : E
  radius : ℝ
  radius_pos : 0 < radius
  radius_le : radius ≤ R
  center_mem : center ∈ Metric.ball x₀ R

  Metric.ball b.center (5 * b.radius)

  intro x hx

  obtain ⟨z, hzc, hzd⟩ := hint
  rw [Metric.mem_ball]
  simp only [Metric.mem_ball] at hzc hzd
  linarith [dist_triangle x c d, dist_triangle c z d, dist_comm z c]

  induction n with

/-! ## Simple Iteration Lemma (AKM, Lemma C.6) -/

/-- **Simple Iteration Lemma** (AKM, Appendix C, Lemma C.6, specialized to ξ = 2).

Suppose `ρ : ℝ → ℝ` satisfies:
1. `ρ ≥ 0` on `[1/2, 1)`,
2. `sup_{t ∈ [1/2,1)} (1-t)² ρ(t) < ∞` (finiteness of weighted supremum),
3. For all `1/2 ≤ s < t < 1`: `ρ(s) ≤ (1/2) ρ(t) + A_iter · (t - s)⁻²`

Then `ρ(1/2) ≤ C_iter · A_iter`.

**Proof sketch** (following AKM):
- Let `M = sup_{t ∈ [1/2,1)} (1-t)² ρ(t)`.
- Choose `δ = 1 - (2/3)^{1/2}` and set `t = 1 - (1-δ)(1-s)` in hypothesis (3).
- Multiply by `(1-s)²` to get: `(1-s)² ρ(s) ≤ (3/4) · (1-t)² ρ(t) + δ⁻² · A_iter`.
- Take supremum: `M ≤ (3/4) M + δ⁻² · A_iter`, hence `M ≤ 4 δ⁻² A_iter`.
- Evaluate at `s = 1/2`: `ρ(1/2) ≤ 2² · M ≤ 4 · 4 · δ⁻² · A_iter ≤ C_iter · A_iter`.
-/

    {ρ : ℝ → ℝ} {A_iter : ℝ}
    (hA_iter : 0 ≤ A_iter)
    (hρ_nonneg : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 / 2 ≤ t → t < 1 → 0 ≤ ρ t)
    (hρ_bdd : ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ t : ℝ, 1 / 2 ≤ t → t < 1 → (1 - t) ^ 2 * ρ t ≤ M)
    (hρ_contract : ∀ s t : ℝ, 1 / 2 ≤ s → s < t → t < 1 →
      ρ s ≤ 1 / 2 * ρ t + A_iter * (t - s) ⁻¹ ^ 2) :
    ρ (1 / 2) ≤ C_iter * A_iter := by sorry

/-- Vitali covering lemma (5r-covering): from any family of balls, one can extract a
disjoint subfamily such that the 5× enlargements cover the union, and every original
ball meets a selected ball of at least half its radius. -/

    (hr_pos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hr_bdd : BddAbove (Set.range r))

lemma ball_subset_fivefold_of_inter_nonempty
    {a c d : E} {ρ r s : ℝ}
    (hsub : Metric.ball a ρ ⊆ Metric.ball c r)
    (hint : (Metric.ball c r ∩ Metric.ball d s).Nonempty)
    (hrad : r ≤ 2 * s) :
    Metric.ball a ρ ⊆ Metric.ball d (5 * s) := by
  intro x hx
  have hxc := Metric.mem_ball.mp (hsub hx)
  obtain ⟨z, hzc, hzd⟩ := hint
  rw [Metric.mem_ball]
  simp only [Metric.mem_ball] at hzc hzd
  linarith [dist_triangle x c d, dist_triangle c z d, dist_comm z c]
lemma john_nirenberg_iteration_decay_iterate
    {E_lam : ℝ → Set E} {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) {θ : ℝ}
    (h_decay : ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → volume (E_lam (lam + A)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal θ * volume (E_lam lam))
    (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (n : ℕ) :
    volume (E_lam (lam + n * A)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal θ ^ n * volume (E_lam lam) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have key : lam + (↑(n + 1)) * A = (lam + ↑n * A) + A := by push_cast; ring
    rw [key]
    calc volume (E_lam (lam + ↑n * A + A))
        ≤ ENNReal.ofReal θ * volume (E_lam (lam + ↑n * A)) :=
          h_decay _ (by positivity)
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal θ * (ENNReal.ofReal θ ^ n * volume (E_lam lam)) :=
          mul_le_mul_right ih _
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal θ ^ (n + 1) * volume (E_lam lam) := by ring
lemma john_nirenberg_iteration_ofReal_pow (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (n : ℕ) :
    ENNReal.ofReal θ ^ n = ENNReal.ofReal (θ ^ n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ, ih, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (pow_nonneg hθ n), pow_succ]
lemma john_nirenberg_iteration_rpow_bound (θ lam A : ℝ) (hθ_pos : 0 < θ) (hθ_lt : θ < 1)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : (↑k : ℝ) ≥ lam / A - 1) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (θ ^ k) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (1 / θ) * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-lam * (-Real.log θ / A))) := by sorry
theorem john_nirenberg_iteration
    {B : Set E} {E_lam : ℝ → Set E}
    (_hB : MeasurableSet B) (_hB_fin : volume B ≠ ⊤)
    (hE_sub : ∀ lam, E_lam lam ⊆ B)
    (_hE_meas : ∀ lam, MeasurableSet (E_lam lam))
    (_hE_anti : ∀ lam₁ lam₂, lam₁ ≤ lam₂ → E_lam lam₂ ⊆ E_lam lam₁)
    {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A)
    {θ : ℝ} (hθ_pos : 0 < θ) (hθ_lt : θ < 1)
    (h_decay : ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → volume (E_lam (lam + A)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal θ * volume (E_lam lam)) :
    ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam →
      volume (E_lam lam) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 / θ) * volume B *
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-lam * (-Real.log θ / A))) := by sorry
theorem john_nirenberg
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {r t A θ : ℝ}
    (_hr : 0 < r) (ht : 0 < t) (hu_meas : Measurable u)
    (hA : 0 < A) (hθ_pos : 0 < θ) (hθ_lt : θ < 1)
    (h_decay : ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam →
      volume ({x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r |
        ‖u x - ⨍ y in Metric.ball x₀ r, u y ∂volume‖ > lam + A}) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal θ *
          volume ({x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r |
            ‖u x - ⨍ y in Metric.ball x₀ r, u y ∂volume‖ > lam})) :
    volume ({x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r |
      ‖u x - ⨍ y in Metric.ball x₀ r, u y ∂volume‖ > t}) ≤
    ENNReal.ofReal (1 / θ) * volume (Metric.ball x₀ r) *
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-t * (-Real.log θ / A))) := by sorry
theorem indicator_bmo_bound
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {r M : ℝ}
    (hu_bmo : ∀ (z : E) (s : ℝ), 0 < s → Metric.closedBall z s ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ r →
      (⨍ x in Metric.ball z s, ‖u x - ⨍ y in Metric.ball z s, u y ∂volume‖ ∂volume) ≤ M)
    (z : E) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (hzs : Metric.closedBall z s ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ r) :
    (⨍ x in Metric.ball z s,

      M := by sorry

/-! ## Simple Iteration Lemma (AKM, Lemma C.6) -/

/-- **Simple Iteration Lemma** (AKM, Appendix C, Lemma C.6, specialized to ξ = 2).

Suppose `ρ : ℝ → ℝ` satisfies:
1. `ρ ≥ 0` on `[1/2, 1)`,
2. `sup_{t ∈ [1/2,1)} (1-t)² ρ(t) < ∞` (finiteness of weighted supremum),
3. For all `1/2 ≤ s < t < 1`: `ρ(s) ≤ (1/2) ρ(t) + A_iter · (t - s)⁻²`

Then `ρ(1/2) ≤ C_iter · A_iter`.

**Proof sketch** (following AKM):
- Let `M = sup_{t ∈ [1/2,1)} (1-t)² ρ(t)`.
- Choose `δ = 1 - (2/3)^{1/2}` and set `t = 1 - (1-δ)(1-s)` in hypothesis (3).
- Multiply by `(1-s)²` to get: `(1-s)² ρ(s) ≤ (3/4) · (1-t)² ρ(t) + δ⁻² · A_iter`.
- Take supremum: `M ≤ (3/4) M + δ⁻² · A_iter`, hence `M ≤ 4 δ⁻² A_iter`.
- Evaluate at `s = 1/2`: `ρ(1/2) ≤ 2² · M ≤ 4 · 4 · δ⁻² · A_iter ≤ C_iter · A_iter`.
-/
theorem simple_iteration_lemma
    {ρ : ℝ → ℝ} {A_iter : ℝ}
    (hA_iter : 0 ≤ A_iter)
    (hρ_nonneg : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 / 2 ≤ t → t < 1 → 0 ≤ ρ t)
    (hρ_bdd : ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ t : ℝ, 1 / 2 ≤ t → t < 1 → (1 - t) ^ 2 * ρ t ≤ M)
    (hρ_contract : ∀ s t : ℝ, 1 / 2 ≤ s → s < t → t < 1 →
      ρ s ≤ 1 / 2 * ρ t + A_iter * (t - s) ⁻¹ ^ 2) :
    ρ (1 / 2) ≤ C_iter * A_iter := by sorry

/-! ## Vitali Covering Lemma -/

/-- Vitali covering lemma (5r-covering): from any family of balls, one can extract a
disjoint subfamily such that the 5× enlargements cover the union, and every original
ball meets a selected ball of at least half its radius. -/
theorem vitali_covering_lemma
    {ι : Type*} {x : ι → E} {r : ι → ℝ}
    (hr_pos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hr_bdd : BddAbove (Set.range r))
    (hfin : (⋃ i, Metric.ball (x i) (r i)).Nonempty) :
    ∃ S : Set ι, S.Countable ∧
      (∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j ∈ S, i ≠ j →
        Disjoint (Metric.ball (x i) (r i)) (Metric.ball (x j) (r j))) ∧
      (∀ i, ∃ j ∈ S,
        (Metric.ball (x i) (r i) ∩ Metric.ball (x j) (r j)).Nonempty ∧ r i ≤ 2 * r j) ∧
      (⋃ i, Metric.ball (x i) (r i)) ⊆ ⋃ i ∈ S, Metric.ball (x i) (5 * r i) := by sorry


lemma volumeReal_ball_eq [NeZero d] (x : E) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    volume.real (Metric.ball x r) = r ^ d * volume.real (Metric.ball (0 : E) 1) := by
  simp only [Measure.real_def]
  rw [Measure.addHaar_ball _ _ hr.le, finrank_euclideanSpace, Fintype.card_fin,
    ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (pow_nonneg hr.le d)]

lemma volumeReal_ball_halves [NeZero d] (x : E) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    volume.real (Metric.ball x r) = (2 : ℝ) ^ d * volume.real (Metric.ball x (r / 2)) := by
  have hr2 : (0 : ℝ) < r / 2 := half_pos hr
  rw [volumeReal_ball_eq _ hr, volumeReal_ball_eq _ hr2]
  have : r ^ d = (2 : ℝ) ^ d * (r / 2) ^ d := by
    rw [div_pow, mul_div_cancel₀ _ (pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0))]
  rw [this]; ring

lemma JNBall.volumeReal_fivefold [NeZero d] {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : JNBall x₀ R) :
    volume.real b.fivefold = (5 : ℝ) ^ d * volume.real b.carrier := by
  simp only [JNBall.fivefold, JNBall.carrier]
  have h5 : (0 : ℝ) < 5 * b.radius := mul_pos (by norm_num) b.radius_pos
  rw [volumeReal_ball_eq _ h5, volumeReal_ball_eq _ b.radius_pos]
  have : (5 * b.radius) ^ d = 5 ^ d * b.radius ^ d := mul_pow 5 b.radius d
  rw [this]; ring

lemma JNBall.volume_fivefold [NeZero d] {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : JNBall x₀ R) :
    volume b.fivefold = ENNReal.ofReal ((5 : ℝ) ^ d) * volume b.carrier := by
  simp only [JNBall.fivefold, JNBall.carrier]
  rw [Measure.addHaar_ball _ _ (mul_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 5) b.radius_pos).le,
      Measure.addHaar_ball _ _ b.radius_pos.le,
      finrank_euclideanSpace, Fintype.card_fin]
  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (pow_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 5) d),
      mul_pow, mul_comm (ENNReal.ofReal _)]
  congr 1
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (pow_nonneg (by linarith) d)]

end DeGiorgi

def IsWeakSolution (P : WeakProblem (d := d)) (u : E → ℝ) : Prop :=
  MemH01 u P.Ω ∧
  ∀ (hwu : MemW1pWitness 2 u P.Ω) (v : E → ℝ), MemH01 v P.Ω →
    ∀ (hwv : MemW1pWitness 2 v P.Ω),
      bilinFormOfCoeff P.coeff hwu hwv = P.rhs v

/-- `u` is a weak subsolution of `-div(A∇u) ≤ 0` on `Ω`. -/
def IsSubsolution {Ω : Set E} (A : EllipticCoeff d Ω) (u : E → ℝ) : Prop :=
  MemW1p 2 u Ω ∧
  ∀ (hu : MemW1pWitness 2 u Ω)
    (φ : E → ℝ), MemH01 φ Ω →
    ∀ (hφ : MemW1pWitness 2 φ Ω),
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x) → bilinFormOfCoeff A hu hφ ≤ 0

/-- `u` is a weak supersolution of `-div(A∇u) ≥ 0` on `Ω`. -/
def IsSupersolution {Ω : Set E} (A : EllipticCoeff d Ω) (u : E → ℝ) : Prop :=
  MemW1p 2 u Ω ∧
  ∀ (hu : MemW1pWitness 2 u Ω)
    (φ : E → ℝ), MemH01 φ Ω →
    ∀ (hφ : MemW1pWitness 2 φ Ω),
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x) → 0 ≤ bilinFormOfCoeff A hu hφ

/-- `u` is a weak solution of the homogeneous equation iff it is both a weak
subsolution and a weak supersolution. -/
def IsSolution {Ω : Set E} (A : EllipticCoeff d Ω) (u : E → ℝ) : Prop :=
  IsSubsolution A u ∧ IsSupersolution A u

/-- `u` is a local weak solution of the homogeneous equation on `Ω` if it lies
in `W^{1,2}(Ω)` and the bilinear form vanishes against every `H₀¹(Ω)` test
function. This is the equality-form local weak-solution interface used by the
Harnack and Holder statements. -/
def IsHomogeneousWeakSolution {Ω : Set E}
    (A : EllipticCoeff d Ω) (u : E → ℝ) : Prop :=
  MemW1p 2 u Ω ∧
  ∀ (hu : MemW1pWitness 2 u Ω)
    (φ : E → ℝ), MemH01 φ Ω →
    ∀ (hφ : MemW1pWitness 2 φ Ω),
      bilinFormOfCoeff A hu hφ = 0

whole-space approximation results used downstream.

      ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) η ∧
      HasCompactSupport η ∧
      Set.range η ⊆ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧

private lemma memW01p_of_global_approx_supported
    {Ω : Set E} {p : ℝ≥0∞} {u : E → ℝ}
    (hw : MemW1pWitness p u Ω)
    (φ : ℕ → E → ℝ)
    (hφ_smooth : ∀ n, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (φ n))
    (hφ_compact : ∀ n, HasCompactSupport (φ n))
    (hφ_sub : ∀ n, tsupport (φ n) ⊆ Ω)
    (hφ_fun :
      Tendsto (fun n => eLpNorm (fun x => φ n x - u x) p (volume.restrict Ω))
        atTop (nhds 0))
    (hφ_grad :
      ∀ i : Fin d, Tendsto (fun n => eLpNorm
        (fun x => (fderiv ℝ (φ n) x) (EuclideanSpace.single i 1) - hw.weakGrad x i)
        p (volume.restrict Ω)) atTop (nhds 0)) :

import DeGiorgi.WeakFormulation.ExistenceTheory

/-!
# Weak Formulation: Weighted Estimates

This module collects the weighted bilinear-form expansion and integrability
estimates used in the Caccioppoli and Moser arguments.
-/

noncomputable section

open MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped InnerProductSpace

namespace DeGiorgi

variable {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]

local notation "E" => AmbientSpace d

/-! ### Bilinear form expansion for smooth-product witnesses

These lemmas expand `bilinFormOfCoeff A hu (η · hw)` into its two constituent
terms. This is the key tool for the Caccioppoli / Moser absorption argument:
the bilinear form against a product test function splits into a "principal" term
(involving `η · ⟪A∇u, ∇w⟫`) and a "cross" term (involving `w · ⟪A∇u, ∇η⟫`). -/

/-- Pointwise expansion of the bilinear-form integrand against a smooth-product
witness `η · w`.

The weak gradient of `η · w` is `η · ∇w + (∇η) · w` (from `mul_smooth_bounded_p`),
so the bilinear-form integrand is:
```
⟪A∇u, ∇(η·w)⟫ = η · ⟪A∇u, ∇w⟫ + w · ⟪A∇u, ∇η⟫
```
where `∇η` is encoded as the vector with components `(fderiv ℝ η x)(single i 1)`.

Note: this is an a.e. identity because `mul_smooth_bounded_p` produces
the gradient `η · ∇w + (∇η) · w` by construction. -/
theorem bilinFormIntegrand_mul_smooth_eq
    {Ω : Set E} (hΩ : IsOpen Ω)
    {u w η : E → ℝ}
    (A : EllipticCoeff d Ω)
    (hu : MemW1pWitness 2 u Ω)
    (hw : MemW1pWitness 2 w Ω)
    (hη : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) η)
    {C₀ C₁ : ℝ} (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) (hC₁ : 0 ≤ C₁)
    (hη_bound : ∀ x, |η x| ≤ C₀)
    (hη_grad_bound : ∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ η x‖ ≤ C₁)
    (hp : (1 : ENNReal) ≤ 2) :
    ∀ x, bilinFormIntegrandOfCoeff A hu
        (hw.mul_smooth_bounded_p (d := d) hp hΩ hη hC₀ hC₁ hη_bound hη_grad_bound) x =
      η x * bilinFormIntegrandOfCoeff A hu hw x +
      w x * ⟪matMulE (A.a x) (hu.weakGrad x),
        (WithLp.toLp 2 fun i =>
          (fderiv ℝ η x) (EuclideanSpace.single i 1) : E)⟫_ℝ := by sorry
private theorem pointwise_weighted_cs_sq
    {f_val : ℝ} {bilin_uv bilin_uu : ℝ} {normAu normv : ℝ} {Λ : ℝ}
    (hbilin_uv : |bilin_uv| ≤ normAu * normv)
    (hAu_sq : normAu ^ 2 ≤ Λ * bilin_uu)
    (_hnormAu : 0 ≤ normAu) (_hnormv : 0 ≤ normv) (_hΛ : 0 ≤ Λ) :
    (f_val * bilin_uv) ^ 2 ≤ (f_val ^ 2 * bilin_uu) * (Λ * normv ^ 2) := by
  have h1 : bilin_uv ^ 2 ≤ (normAu * normv) ^ 2 :=
    sq_le_sq' (abs_le.mp hbilin_uv).1 (abs_le.mp hbilin_uv).2
  have h2 : (normAu * normv) ^ 2 = normAu ^ 2 * normv ^ 2 := by ring
  have h3 : normAu ^ 2 * normv ^ 2 ≤ (Λ * bilin_uu) * normv ^ 2 :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hAu_sq (sq_nonneg _)
  calc (f_val * bilin_uv) ^ 2 = f_val ^ 2 * bilin_uv ^ 2 := by ring
    _ ≤ f_val ^ 2 * ((Λ * bilin_uu) * normv ^ 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_trans h1 (h2 ▸ h3)) (sq_nonneg _)
    _ = (f_val ^ 2 * bilin_uu) * (Λ * normv ^ 2) := by ring
private theorem sq_le_of_le_rpow_half_mul {a b c : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (h : c ≤ a ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) * b ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) :
    c ^ (2 : ℕ) ≤ a * b := by
  have h1 : c ^ 2 ≤ (a ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) * b ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) ^ 2 :=
    sq_le_sq' (by nlinarith) h
  have h2 : (a ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) ^ 2 = a := by
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha'
    · simp
    · rw [sq, ← Real.rpow_add ha']; norm_num
  have h3 : (b ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) ^ 2 = b := by
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hb with rfl | hb'

  have hf_lo := hf.hasFDerivAt.isLittleO

    c = 0 := by

  obtain ⟨y, hyx, hy_close, hfy⟩ := hni δ hδ

    (by rwa [abs_pos, sub_ne_zero]) hy_close
  simp at this

/-- In ℝ, the set of isolated points of any subset S is countable.

Proof: cover by ⋃_{p,q ∈ ℚ} {unique element of S in (p,q)}.
Each fiber has at most one element (uniqueness), and ℚ × ℚ is countable. -/
theorem countable_isolated (S : Set ℝ) :
    Set.Countable {x ∈ S | ∃ ε > 0, ∀ y ∈ S, dist y x < ε → y = x} := by sorry

    ∀ᵐ x, f x = 0 → deriv f x = 0 := by sorry

### Helper lemmas

/-- Smooth (C^1) functions are absolutely continuous on intervals.
Proof: continuous derivative → bounded on compact [a,b] → Lipschitz → AC. -/
private theorem contDiff_ac {a b : ℝ} {φ : ℝ → ℝ} (hφ : ContDiff ℝ 1 φ) :
    AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval φ a b := by sorry

private lemma setIntegral_Ioo_eq_interval {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    ∫ x in Ioo a b, f x = ∫ x in a..b, f x := by
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab]
  congr 1; exact Measure.restrict_congr_set Ioo_ae_eq_Ioc

private lemma integrableOn_Ioo_intervalIntegrable {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : IntegrableOn f (Ioo a b) volume) :
    IntervalIntegrable f volume a b := by
  rw [intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le hab]
  rwa [IntegrableOn, ← Measure.restrict_congr_set Ioo_ae_eq_Ioc]

private theorem integrableOn_Icc_of_Ioo {g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hg : IntegrableOn g (Ioo a b) volume) :
    IntegrableOn g (Icc a b) volume := by
  rwa [IntegrableOn, ← Measure.restrict_congr_set Ioo_ae_eq_Icc]

private theorem integrable_primitive {a b : ℝ} (_hab : a < b) {g : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hg : IntegrableOn g (Ioo a b) volume) :
    IntegrableOn (fun x => ∫ t in a..x, g t) (Ioo a b) volume := by sorry
private theorem ac_ibp_step {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b) {g φ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hg : IntegrableOn g (Ioo a b) volume)
    (hφ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ) (hφ_supp : tsupport φ ⊆ Ioo a b) :
    ∫ x in a..b, (∫ t in a..x, g t) * deriv φ x =
      -(∫ x in a..b, g x * φ x) := by sorry
private theorem exists_antideriv_of_zero_integral {a b : ℝ} (_hab : a < b)
    {η : ℝ → ℝ} (hη : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) η) (hη_cs : HasCompactSupport η)
    (hη_supp : tsupport η ⊆ Ioo a b) (hη_int : ∫ x, η x = 0) :
    ∃ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ ∧ HasCompactSupport φ ∧
      tsupport φ ⊆ Ioo a b ∧ ∀ x, deriv φ x = η x := by sorry
private theorem smooth_cutoff_approximation {a b : ℝ} (_hab : a < b)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : IntegrableOn f (Ioo a b) volume)
    {ψ : ℝ → ℝ} (_hψ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ψ) (_hψ_cs : HasCompactSupport ψ)
    (hmain : ∀ η : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) η → HasCompactSupport η →
      tsupport η ⊆ Ioo a b → ∫ x in Ioo a b, f x * η x = 0) :
    ∫ x in Ioo a b, f x * ψ x = 0 := by sorry

private lemma integrable_of_smooth_cs {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) f) (hf_cs : HasCompactSupport f) : Integrable f :=
  hf.continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hf_cs

private lemma integrableOn_mul_of_smooth_cs {a b : ℝ} {g f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hg : IntegrableOn g (Ioo a b) volume)
    (hf_cont : Continuous f) (hf_cs : HasCompactSupport f) :
    IntegrableOn (fun x => g x * f x) (Ioo a b) volume := by sorry

private lemma support_sub_tsupport {f g : ℝ → ℝ} :
    support (f - g) ⊆ tsupport f ∪ tsupport g := by
  intro x hx
  rw [Function.mem_support, Pi.sub_apply] at hx
  by_contra habs
  simp only [Set.mem_union, not_or] at habs
  have hf : f x = 0 := by
    by_contra hf'; exact habs.1 (subset_tsupport f (Function.mem_support.mpr hf'))
  have hg : g x = 0 := by
    by_contra hg'; exact habs.2 (subset_tsupport g (Function.mem_support.mpr hg'))
  exact hx (by simp [hf, hg])
theorem du_bois_reymond
    {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : IntegrableOn g (Ioo a b) volume)
    (htest : ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
      tsupport φ ⊆ Ioo a b → ∫ x in Ioo a b, g x * deriv φ x = 0) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, g =ᵐ[volume.restrict (Ioo a b)] fun _ => C := by sorry
theorem w11_ae_eq_ac_representative
    {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b) {u g : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hu : IntegrableOn u (Ioo a b) volume)
    (hg : IntegrableOn g (Ioo a b) volume)
    (hweak : ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
      tsupport φ ⊆ Ioo a b →
      ∫ x in Ioo a b, u x * deriv φ x = -∫ x in Ioo a b, g x * φ x) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, u =ᵐ[volume.restrict (Ioo a b)]
      fun x => C + ∫ t in a..x, g t := by sorry
theorem stampacchia_1d {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b) {u g : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hu : IntegrableOn u (Ioo a b) volume)
    (hg : IntegrableOn g (Ioo a b) volume)
    (hweak : ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
      tsupport φ ⊆ Ioo a b →
      ∫ x in Ioo a b, u x * deriv φ x = -∫ x in Ioo a b, g x * φ x) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (Ioo a b)), u x = 0 → g x = 0 := by sorry

/-! ## Section 4: d-dimensional Stampacchia via truncation

Instead of Fubini, we use the truncation approach: compose u with smooth
approximations Φ_ε of the sign function, apply the Sobolev chain rule to get
∫ Φ_ε(u)·∂ᵢψ = -∫ Φ_ε'(u)·Gᵢ·ψ, then take ε → 0.
-/

/-- For each ε > 0, there exists a smooth truncation Φ_ε with Φ_ε(0) = 0,
|Φ_ε| ≤ ε, |Φ_ε'| ≤ 1, and Φ_ε'(s) = 1 for |s| ≤ ε/2.

Construction: take β = ContDiffBump 0 with rIn = ε/2, rOut = ε.
Define Φ(s) = ∫₀ˢ β(t) dt. Then Φ' = β, giving all properties. -/
private theorem exists_smooth_trunc (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ Φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) Φ ∧ Φ 0 = 0 ∧
      (∀ s, |Φ s| ≤ ε) ∧ (∀ s, |deriv Φ s| ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ s, |s| ≤ ε / 2 → deriv Φ s = 1) ∧
      (∀ s, ε ≤ |s| → deriv Φ s = 0) := by sorry
private theorem exists_smooth_trunc' (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ Φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) Φ ∧ Φ 0 = 0 ∧
      (∀ s, |Φ s| ≤ ε) ∧ (∀ s, |deriv Φ s| ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ s, |s| ≤ ε / 2 → deriv Φ s = 1) ∧
      (∀ s, ε ≤ |s| → deriv Φ s = 0) := by sorry
private theorem weakGrad_integral_test_eq_zero
    {Ω : Set E} (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) {u : E → ℝ}
    (hu : MemW1p 2 u Ω) (hu_meas : Measurable u)
    {G : E → E} (hG : ∀ i, HasWeakPartialDeriv' i (fun x => G x i) u Ω) (i : Fin d)
    (hGi_mem : MemLp (fun x => G x i) 2 (volume.restrict Ω))
    (ψ : E → ℝ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ψ) (hψ_cs : HasCompactSupport ψ)
    (hψ_supp : tsupport ψ ⊆ Ω) :
    ∫ x, ψ x • (fun x => if u x = 0 then G x i else 0) x = 0 := by sorry

private theorem weakGrad_locallyIntegrableOn
    {Ω : Set E} (_hΩ : IsOpen Ω) {u : E → ℝ} (_hu : MemW1p 2 u Ω)
    {G : E → E} (_hG : ∀ i, HasWeakPartialDeriv' i (fun x => G x i) u Ω) (i : Fin d)
    (hGi_mem : MemLp (fun x => G x i) 2 (volume.restrict Ω))
    (hu_meas : Measurable u) :
    LocallyIntegrableOn (fun x => if u x = 0 then G x i else 0) Ω := by sorry

theorem weakGrad_ae_eq_zero_on_zeroSet
    {Ω : Set E} (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) {u : E → ℝ}
    (hu : MemW1p 2 u Ω)
    {G : E → E} (hG : ∀ i, HasWeakPartialDeriv' i (fun x => G x i) u Ω) (i : Fin d)
    (hGi_mem : MemLp (fun x => G x i) 2 (volume.restrict Ω))
    (hu_meas : Measurable u) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict Ω), u x = 0 → G x i = 0 := by sorry

end DeGiorgi

    {c : E} (hc : c ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E) (1 / 2 : ℝ))
    {r : ℝ} (_hr_nonneg : 0 ≤ r) (hr_half : r ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) :
    Metric.closedBall c r ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E) 1 := by
  intro x hx

private lemma affine_map_restrict_ball_mul
    {x₀ : E} {R ρ : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) :
    Measure.map (fun z : E => x₀ + R • z) (volume.restrict (Metric.ball (0 : E) ρ)) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (|R ^ Module.finrank ℝ E|⁻¹) •
        (volume.restrict (Metric.ball x₀ (R * ρ))) := by sorry
noncomputable def C_harnack (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] : ℝ :=
  17 *
    (((d : ℝ) - 2) / ((d : ℝ) - 1) *
        Real.log
          (C_Moser d * (((d : ℝ) - 1) ^ (d : ℝ)) * ((4 : ℝ) ^ (d : ℝ))) +
      (d : ℝ) +
      Real.log (C_weakHarnack_of d * ((d : ℝ) ^ (weak_harnack_decay_exp d))))

/-- Quantitative constant for the Moser Hölder theorem. -/
noncomputable def C_holder_Moser (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] : ℝ :=
  (256 : ℝ) *
    (|C_harnack d| +
      C_Moser d * (((d : ℝ) - 1) ^ (d : ℝ)) * ((4 : ℝ) ^ (d : ℝ)) +
      C_Moser d * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (d : ℝ)) +
      C_weakHarnack_of d * ((d : ℝ) ^ (d : ℝ)) + 8)

private noncomputable def quarterBallInf
    (u : E → ℝ) (c : E) : ℝ :=
  essInf (fun z : E => u (c + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • z))
    (volume.restrict (Metric.ball (0 : E) (1 / 4 : ℝ)))

private noncomputable def localHarnackConstant
    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (Metric.ball (0 : E) 1)) : ℝ :=
  (localMoserBase d * A.1.Λ ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2)) ^ ((harnack_p d)⁻¹) *
    localWeakHarnackBase d ^ (A.1.Λ ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2))

    (hd : 2 < (d : ℝ))
    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (Metric.ball (0 : E) 1)) :

  unfold localMoserBase

  rw [harnack_p_div_sub_eq hd]

    C_weakHarnack d hd / (1 - harnack_q d) ^ (weak_harnack_decay_exp d) =
      localWeakHarnackBase d := by
  sorry

    {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) :

import re
import os

def extract_theorems_with_sorry(filepath):
    with open(filepath, 'r') as f:
        lines = f.readlines()
    
    results = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(lines):
        # Look for theorem/lemma/def
        if re.match(r'^(theorem|lemma|def) ', lines[i]):
            start_line = i + 1  # 1-indexed for user
            stmt = lines[i].rstrip()
            i += 1
            # Collect until we see 'by'
            paren_depth = 0
            while i < len(lines):
                line = lines[i]
                stmt += '\n' + line.rstrip()
                if 'by sorry' in line:
                    results.append((filepath, start_line, stmt))
                    break
                i += 1
        i += 1
    return results

# Search all .lean files
directory = '/home/vincent/rrma-degiorgi-workspace/DeGiorgi'
all_results = []
for filename in sorted(os.listdir(directory)):
    if filename.endswith('.lean'):
        filepath = os.path.join(directory, filename)
        all_results.extend(extract_theorems_with_sorry(filepath))

# Print out results
for filepath, line_num, stmt in all_results[:150]:
    fname = os.path.basename(filepath)
    # Check for simple patterns
    if any(pat in stmt for pat in ['0 <', '0 ≤', 'def ', '∈', '⊆', 'rfl']):
        print(f"\n{fname}:{line_num}:")
        print(stmt[:200])
        print("...")
EOF

import re
import os

def extract_full_theorem(filepath):
    with open(filepath, 'r') as f:
        content = f.read()
        lines = content.split('\n')
    
    results = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(lines):
        if re.match(r'^(theorem|lemma|def) ', lines[i]):
            start_line = i + 1  # 1-indexed
            stmt_lines = [lines[i]]
            i += 1
            while i < len(lines) and not re.search(r'by sorry', lines[i]):
                stmt_lines.append(lines[i])
                i += 1
            if i < len(lines) and 'by sorry' in lines[i]:
                stmt_lines.append(lines[i])
                results.append({
                    'file': filepath,
                    'line': start_line,
                    'stmt': '\n'.join(stmt_lines).strip(),
                    'filename': os.path.basename(filepath)
                })
            i += 1
        else:
            i += 1
    
    return results

# Collect all results
directory = '/home/vincent/rrma-degiorgi-workspace/DeGiorgi'
all_results = []
for filename in sorted(os.listdir(directory)):
    if filename.endswith('.lean'):
        filepath = os.path.join(directory, filename)
        all_results.extend(extract_full_theorem(filepath))

# Score and sort by simplicity
def simplicity_score(result):
    stmt = result['stmt'].lower()
    # Simple patterns: positivity, nonneg, set membership, equality
    score = 0
    
    # Positivity/nonnegativity (simple!)
    if '0 <' in stmt or '0 ≤' in stmt:
        score += 10
    if 'pos' in stmt:
        score += 5
    if 'nonneg' in stmt:
        score += 5
    
    # Set membership/containment (medium)
    if ' ∈ ' in stmt or '⊆' in stmt or 'mem' in stmt.replace('member',''):
        score += 3
    
    # Equality/definitional (hard to score)
    if '=' in stmt and 'by sorry' in stmt:
        score += 2
    
    # Penalize complex structures
    lines = stmt.count('\n')
    if lines > 15:
        score -= 5
    
    # Penalize complex function spaces
    if 'MemW' in stmt or 'Lp' in stmt or 'eLp' in stmt:
        score -= 3
    if 'Integral' in stmt or 'integral' in stmt:
        score -= 2
    if 'measur' in stmt.lower() or 'ae' in stmt.lower():
        score -= 2
    
    return score

# Sort by score
scored = [(r, simplicity_score(r)) for r in all_results]
scored.sort(key=lambda x: -x[1])

# Print top 15
for idx, (result, score) in enumerate(scored[:20], 1):
    stmt = result['stmt']
    # Shorten for display
    if len(stmt) > 300:
        stmt = stmt[:300] + "..."
    print(f"\n{idx}. {result['filename']}:{result['line']} (score: {score})")
    print(f"   {stmt}")
    print()

/-! ### Constants for the crossover estimate -/

/-- The small exponent `c(d)` in the crossover estimate.
This is chosen small enough for the local John-Nirenberg step fed by the
regularized-log BMO bound. -/
noncomputable def c_crossover_bmo_scale (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] : ℝ :=
  ((volume.real (Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) 1)) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) * C_poinc_val d) *
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - (d : ℝ) / 2) *
    (8 * (Mst : ℝ) * (volume.real (Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) 1)) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2))

noncomputable def crossover_big_bmo_scale (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] : ℝ :=
  12 * (Mst : ℝ) * C_poinc_val d * (4 / 3 : ℝ) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2)

noncomputable def c_crossover' (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] : ℝ :=
  1 / (2 * C_JN d * c_crossover_bmo_scale d + 1)

/-- Local exponential-integrability bound for a positive supersolution on a
cover ball.

Given a positive supersolution `u` on `B₁` and a cover center `x₀` with
`closedBall x₀ (1/4) ⊆ ball 0 1`, the exponential weight
`exp(c(a - (-log u)))` has controlled L¹ norm on `ball x₀ (1/8)`.

The proof rescales `B(x₀, 3/8)` to `B₁`, uses the log gradient bound and
Poincaré inequality to control the BMO seminorm of `-log u`, and then applies
the local John-Nirenberg inequality to obtain exponential integrability on a
smaller ball. -/
private theorem local_exp_integrability_bound
    (_hd : 2 < (d : ℝ))
    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (Metric.ball (0 : E) 1))

/-!
# Holder Local Bounds

Local dyadic-radius setup, local Moser bounds, and positivity packaging used in
the Holder endpoint.
-/

noncomputable section

open MeasureTheory Filter

namespace DeGiorgi

variable {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]

local notation "E" => AmbientSpace d
local notation "μ1" => volume.restrict (Metric.ball (0 : E) 1)
local notation "μhalf" => volume.restrict (Metric.ball (0 : E) (1 / 2 : ℝ))

noncomputable def moserDyadicRadius (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 4 : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ n

noncomputable def ballMeasure (x : E) (r : ℝ) : Measure E :=
  volume.restrict (Metric.ball x r)

noncomputable def moserDyadicEssSup
    (u : E → ℝ) (x : E) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  essSup u (ballMeasure x (moserDyadicRadius n))

noncomputable def moserDyadicEssInf
    (u : E → ℝ) (x : E) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  essInf u (ballMeasure x (moserDyadicRadius n))

noncomputable def moserHolderNorm
    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (Metric.ball (0 : E) 1))
    (u : E → ℝ) (p₀ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  A.1.Λ ^ ((d : ℝ) / (2 * p₀)) *
    (p₀ / (p₀ - 1)) ^ ((d : ℝ) / p₀) *
    (∫ z in Metric.ball (0 : E) 1, |u z| ^ p₀ ∂volume) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / p₀)

import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Layercake
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.ImproperIntegrals
import DeGiorgi.Crossover.LocalIntegrability
import DeGiorgi.Oscillation
import DeGiorgi.SobolevChainRule
import DeGiorgi.UnitBallApproximation
import DeGiorgi.Localization
import DeGiorgi.Supersolutions

/-!
# Chapter 06: Crossover Logarithmic Gradient Layer

This module proves the logarithmic gradient bound for positive supersolutions,
which is the PDE input for the crossover estimate.
-/

noncomputable section

open MeasureTheory Metric Filter Set
open scoped ENNReal NNReal Topology RealInnerProductSpace

namespace DeGiorgi

variable {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]

local notation "E" => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
local notation "Cmo" =>
  ((volume.real (Metric.ball (0 : E) 1)) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) * C_poinc_val d)

/-! ### Logarithmic Gradient Bound for Supersolutions

The key PDE step for the crossover estimate: if `u > 0` is a supersolution
on `B₁`, then `v = -log u` satisfies the weighted gradient bound
`∫ φ² |∇v|² ≤ 4Λ ∫ |∇φ|²` for every smooth cutoff `φ ∈ H₀¹(B₁)`.

Proof strategy:
1. For `ε > 0`, define `Φ_ε(t) = 1/(t+ε) - 1/ε`. Note `Φ_ε(0) = 0` and
   `|Φ_ε'(t)| ≤ 1/ε²`, so the Sobolev chain rule applies.
2. `Φ_ε ∘ u ∈ W^{1,2}` with `∇(Φ_ε ∘ u) = -∇u/(u+ε)²`.
3. Form test function `ψ_ε = φ² · (1/(u+ε) - 1/ε) + φ²/ε = φ²/(u+ε)`.
   This is nonneg and in `H₀¹(B₁)` (smooth × Sobolev product rule).
4. Supersolution: `0 ≤ ∫ ⟨A∇u, ∇ψ_ε⟩ = -∫ φ² ⟨A∇v_ε, ∇v_ε⟩ + 2∫ φ⟨A∇v_ε, ∇φ⟩`
   where `v_ε = -log(u+ε)`.
5. By Cauchy-Schwarz on the A-inner product and `⟨∇φ, A∇φ⟩ ≤ Λ|∇φ|²`:
   `∫ φ² |∇v_ε|² ≤ 4Λ ∫ |∇φ|²`.
6. Send `ε → 0` (monotone convergence). -/

-- We use Φ_ε(t) = 1/(√(t²+ε²)) - 1/ε as the regularized reciprocal.
-- This is smooth on all of ℝ (no singularity), Φ_ε(0) = 0, and |Φ_ε'| ≤ 1/ε².
-- On the positive reals, Φ_ε(t) ≈ 1/(t+ε) - 1/ε for large t/ε.
-- The exact form doesn't matter much — we only need the chain rule hypotheses
-- and the ε → 0 convergence on {u > 0}.
--
-- For the proof, the key properties are:
--   (1) Φ_ε(0) = 0
--   (2) ContDiff ℝ ⊤ Φ_ε
--   (3) |Φ_ε'| ≤ M_ε for some M_ε
-- These feed into sobolev_chain_rule / MemW1pWitness.comp_smooth_bounded.

/-- Smooth regularized reciprocal for the chain rule.

For `ε > 0`, the function `Φ_ε(t) = 1/(t+ε) - 1/ε` is smooth on `(-ε, ∞)`,
vanishes at 0, and has derivative `-1/(t+ε)²` bounded by `1/ε²`.
To get a globally smooth function (required by `sobolev_chain_rule`),
we define `Φ_ε(t) = 1/√(t²+ε²) - 1/ε` which is `C^∞(ℝ)` since `t²+ε² > 0`.
On `(0, ∞)`, it agrees with the desired approximation up to controlled error. -/
private noncomputable def recipApprox (ε : ℝ) : ℝ → ℝ :=
  fun t => 1 / Real.sqrt (t ^ 2 + ε ^ 2) - 1 / ε

private lemma recipApprox_zero {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) : recipApprox ε 0 = 0 := by sorry

private lemma recipApprox_contDiff {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (recipApprox ε) := by sorry

private lemma recipApprox_deriv_bounded {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ t, |deriv (recipApprox ε) t| ≤ M := by sorry
private lemma exists_smooth_logApprox {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ (Ψ : ℝ → ℝ),
      Ψ 0 = 0 ∧
      ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) Ψ ∧
      (∃ M, ∀ t, |deriv Ψ t| ≤ M) ∧
      (∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Ψ t = -Real.log (t + ε) + Real.log ε) ∧
      (∀ t, 0 < t → deriv Ψ t = -(1 / (t + ε))) := by sorry

private noncomputable def smoothLogApprox {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) : ℝ → ℝ :=
  Classical.choose (exists_smooth_logApprox hε)

private lemma smoothLogApprox_zero {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    smoothLogApprox hε 0 = 0 :=
  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_smooth_logApprox hε)).1

private lemma smoothLogApprox_smooth {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (smoothLogApprox hε) :=
  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_smooth_logApprox hε)).2.1

private lemma smoothLogApprox_deriv_bdd {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ M, ∀ t, |deriv (smoothLogApprox hε) t| ≤ M :=
  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_smooth_logApprox hε)).2.2.1

private lemma smoothLogApprox_eq {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → smoothLogApprox hε t = -Real.log (t + ε) + Real.log ε :=
  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_smooth_logApprox hε)).2.2.2.1

private lemma smoothLogApprox_deriv {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ t, 0 < t → deriv (smoothLogApprox hε) t = -(1 / (t + ε)) :=
  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_smooth_logApprox hε)).2.2.2.2

/-! #### Logarithmic gradient bound

If `u > 0` satisfies `-∇·(A∇u) ≥ 0` on `Ω`, then for every smooth cutoff
`φ` supported in `Ω`:
`∫_Ω φ² |∇u|²/u² ≤ 4Λ ∫_Ω |∇φ|²`.

Equivalently, setting `v = -log u`: `∫_Ω φ² |∇v|² ≤ 4Λ ∫_Ω |∇φ|²`.

-/

/-- A globally smooth extension of `t ↦ 1/(t+ε) - 1/ε` to all of `ℝ`,
agreeing with it on `(-ε/2, ∞)` (hence on the range of any `u > 0`).
This is obtained by multiplying by a smooth bump that's 1 on `[-ε/2, ∞)`.
The key properties: `Φ(0) = 0`, `ContDiff ℝ ⊤ Φ`, `|Φ'| ≤ M_ε`, and
on `{t > 0}`: `Φ(t) = 1/(t+ε) - 1/ε` and `Φ'(t) = -1/(t+ε)²`. -/
private lemma exists_smooth_recipApprox {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ (Φ : ℝ → ℝ),
      Φ 0 = 0 ∧
      ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) Φ ∧
      (∃ M, ∀ t, |deriv Φ t| ≤ M) ∧
      (∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Φ t = 1 / (t + ε) - 1 / ε) ∧
      (∀ t, 0 < t → deriv Φ t = -(1 / (t + ε) ^ 2)) := by sorry
private noncomputable def comp_smooth_bounded_witness
    {Ω : Set E} (hΩ : IsOpen Ω)
    {u : E → ℝ} (hu : MemW1pWitness 2 u Ω)
    (Φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hΦ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) Φ) (hΦ0 : Φ 0 = 0)
    (hΦ'_bdd : ∃ M, ∀ t, |deriv Φ t| ≤ M) :
    MemW1pWitness 2 (fun x => Φ (u x)) Ω := by sorry
noncomputable def regularizedLogFun

`moserExponentSeq d p₀ n = p₀ * moserChi d ^ n`

So `moserExponentSeq d (q * (moserChi d)⁻¹ ^ m) (m + 1) = (q * (moserChi d)⁻¹ ^ m) * moserChi d ^ (m + 1)`
= `q * (moserChi d)⁻¹ ^ m * moserChi d ^ (m+1)` 
= `q * (moserChi d)⁻¹ ^ m * moserChi d ^ m * moserChi d`


= `q * ((moserChi d)⁻¹ * moserChi d) ^ m * moserChi d`
= `q * 1 ^ m * moserChi d`
= `q * moserChi d`

The algebra simplifies nicely as long as moserChi d isn't zero.

import DeGiorgi.Supersolutions.ForwardIteration
import DeGiorgi.Supersolutions.InverseIteration

/-!
# Supersolutions Stage-One Theorems

This module contains the two stage-one weak Harnack theorems for positive
supersolutions, assembled from the inverse and forward iteration layers.
-/

noncomputable section

open MeasureTheory Metric

namespace DeGiorgi

variable {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]

local notation "E" => AmbientSpace d
local notation "μhalf" => (volume.restrict (Metric.ball (0 : E) (1 / 2 : ℝ)))

/-! ### Main theorems -/

set_option maxHeartbeats 5000000 in
/-- First stage of weak Harnack: inverse-power iteration for positive
supersolutions.

For `u > 0` a supersolution on `B₁` and every `p₀ > 0`:
```
(Λ p₀² + 1)^{-d/2} · (∫_{B₁} |u⁻¹|^{p₀})⁻¹ ≤ C · (inf_{B_{1/2}} u)^{p₀}
```
Proof: the Moser iteration (Steps 1-2 above) gives an a.e. `L^∞` bound on
`u⁻¹` over `B_{1/2}`. Since `u > 0` pointwise, this converts to a lower
bound on `inf u`, which we rearrange to get the stated inequality. -/
theorem weak_harnack_stage_one_inverse
    (hd : 2 < (d : ℝ))
    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (Metric.ball (0 : E) 1))
    {u : E → ℝ} {p₀ : ℝ} (hp₀ : 0 < p₀)
    (hu_pos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E) 1, 0 < u x)
    (hsuper : IsSupersolution A.1 u) :
    (A.1.Λ * p₀ ^ 2 + 1) ^ (-(d : ℝ) / 2) *
        (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E) 1, |(u x)⁻¹| ^ p₀ ∂volume)⁻¹ ≤
      C_weakHarnack0 d *
        (essInf u μhalf) ^ p₀ := by sorry

private theorem superIterNormFwd_zero
    {u : E → ℝ} {p₀ : ℝ} :
    superIterNormFwd (d := d) (u := u) p₀ 0 =
      (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E) 1, |u x| ^ p₀ ∂volume) ^ (1 / p₀) := by sorry

private theorem moserExponentSeq_forward_target_eq
    (hd : 2 < (d : ℝ))
    {q : ℝ} {m : ℕ} :
    moserExponentSeq d (q * (moserChi d)⁻¹ ^ m) (m + 1) = q * moserChi d := by sorry

private theorem superIterNormFwd_target
    (hd : 2 < (d : ℝ))
    {u : E → ℝ} {q : ℝ} {m : ℕ} :
    let p₀ := q * (moserChi d)⁻¹ ^ m
    superIterNormFwd (d := d) (u := u) p₀ (m + 1) =
      (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E) (moserRadius (m + 1)),
          |u x| ^ (q * moserChi d) ∂volume) ^ (1 / (q * moserChi d)) := by sorry

private noncomputable def weakHarnackForwardUpgradeLHS
    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (Metric.ball (0 : E) 1))
    (u : E → ℝ) (p q p₀ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (((C_weakHarnack0 d *
        (A.1.Λ * p₀ ^ 2 / (1 - q) ^ 2 + 1) ^ ((d : ℝ) / 2)) ^
          (1 / p₀)) *
      (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E) 1, |u x| ^ p₀ ∂volume) ^
        (1 / p₀)) ^ p

private noncomputable def weakHarnackForwardUpgradeRHS
    (hd : 2 < (d : ℝ))
    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (Metric.ball (0 : E) 1))
    (u : E → ℝ) (p q : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  C_weakHarnack0Forward (d := d) hd *
    (A.1.Λ * p ^ 2 / (1 - q) ^ 2 + 1) ^ (((d : ℝ) * moserChi d) / 2) *
    ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E) 1, |u x| ^ p ∂volume

private theorem weak_harnack_stage_one_forward_power_upgrade
    (hd : 2 < (d : ℝ))
    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (Metric.ball (0 : E) 1))
    {u : E → ℝ} {p q p₀ : ℝ}
    (hp₀ : 0 < p₀) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hp1 : p < 1)
    (hp₀_lt_p : p₀ < p)
    (hp_le : p ≤ moserChi d * p₀)
    (_hq1 : q < 1)
    (hsuper : IsSupersolution A.1 u)
    (_hp₀Int :
      IntegrableOn (fun x => |u x| ^ p₀)
        (Metric.ball (0 : E) 1) volume) :
    weakHarnackForwardUpgradeLHS (d := d) A u p q p₀ ≤
      weakHarnackForwardUpgradeRHS (d := d) hd A u p q := by sorry

set_option maxHeartbeats 5000000 in
/-- Second stage of weak Harnack: forward low-power iteration for positive
supersolutions.

For `u > 0` a supersolution on `B₁` and `0 < p < q < 1`:
```
‖u‖_{L^{qd/(d-2)}(B_{1/2})}^p ≤
  C_fwd(d) (Λp²/(1-q)² + 1)^{dχ/2} ‖u‖_{Lᵖ(B₁)}^p
```
The theorem is stated for arbitrary `0 < p < q < 1`, with the nonlinear factor
raised to `dχ/2`.

Proof: choose `m` large enough that `p₀ = q χ^{-m} ≤ p`, then apply the
finite forward iteration to get `‖u‖_{L^{qχ}(B_{r_{m+1}})} ≤ C · ‖u‖_{L^{p₀}(B₁)}`,
use `B_{1/2} ⊂ B_{r_{m+1}}` and `p₀ ≤ p` to convert, raise to the `p`-th power,
and apply the geometric majorant bound. -/
theorem weak_harnack_stage_one_forward
    (hd : 2 < (d : ℝ))
    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (Metric.ball (0 : E) 1))
    {u : E → ℝ} {p q : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hpq : p < q) (hq1 : q < 1)
    (hu_pos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E) 1, 0 < u x)
    (hsuper : IsSupersolution A.1 u) :
    (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E) (1 / 2 : ℝ),
        |u x| ^ (q * (d : ℝ) / ((d : ℝ) - 2)) ∂volume) ^
          (p * (((d : ℝ) - 2) / (q * (d : ℝ)))) ≤
      C_weakHarnack0Forward (d := d) hd *
        (A.1.Λ * p ^ 2 / (1 - q) ^ 2 + 1) ^ (((d : ℝ) * moserChi d) / 2) *
        ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E) 1, |u x| ^ p ∂volume := by sorry

end DeGiorgi

/-- `C_weakHarnack` with a built-in decidability check so that definitions
and constants that mention it need not carry an explicit `hd` proof. When
`2 < d` this equals `C_weakHarnack d hd`; otherwise it defaults to `1`. -/
noncomputable def C_weakHarnack_of (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] : ℝ :=
  if hd : 2 < (d : ℝ) then C_weakHarnack d hd else 1

theorem C_weakHarnack_of_eq (hd : 2 < (d : ℝ)) :
    C_weakHarnack_of d = C_weakHarnack d hd :=
  dif_pos hd

theorem one_le_C_weakHarnack_of : 1 ≤ C_weakHarnack_of d := by sorry

omit [NeZero d] in
private lemma inverse_affine_preimage_ball_mul
    {x₀ : E} {R ρ : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) :
    (fun x : E => R⁻¹ • (x - x₀)) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (0 : E) ρ = Metric.ball x₀ (R * ρ) := by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, sub_zero,
    norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hR.le)]

import DeGiorgi.Oscillation.BMO

/-!
# Chapter 02: Campanato and Holder Theory

This module packages the Campanato seminorm machinery and the equivalence with
Holder regularity.
-/

noncomputable section

open MeasureTheory Metric Filter Set
open scoped ENNReal NNReal Topology

namespace DeGiorgi

variable {d : ℕ}

local notation "E" => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)

/-! ## Campanato Characterization of Hölder Spaces -/

/-- Admissible sub-balls of `Metric.ball x₀ R` for the Campanato seminorm. -/
def CampanatoBall (x₀ : E) (R : ℝ) :=
  {p : E × ℝ // 0 < p.2 ∧ p.2 ≤ R ∧ Metric.ball p.1 p.2 ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R}

namespace CampanatoBall

def center {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) : E := b.1.1

def radius {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) : ℝ := b.1.2

lemma radius_pos {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) : 0 < b.radius := b.2.1

lemma radius_le {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) : b.radius ≤ R := b.2.2.1

lemma subset_ball {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) :
    Metric.ball b.center b.radius ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R := b.2.2.2

end CampanatoBall

/-- The Campanato seminorm on a ball B_R(x₀):
sup_{B ⊆ B_R} ⨍_B |u - (u)_B|. -/
noncomputable def campanatoBallValue
    (u : E → ℝ) (α : ℝ) {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) : ℝ :=
  (CampanatoBall.radius b)⁻¹ ^ α *
    ⨍ x in Metric.ball (CampanatoBall.center b) (CampanatoBall.radius b),
      |u x - ⨍ z in Metric.ball (CampanatoBall.center b) (CampanatoBall.radius b), u z| ∂volume

noncomputable def campanatoSeminorm (u : E → ℝ) (x₀ : E) (R : ℝ) (α : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sSup (Set.range (campanatoBallValue u α (x₀ := x₀) (R := R)))

lemma campanatoBallValue_nonneg
    {u : E → ℝ} {α : ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) :
    0 ≤ campanatoBallValue u α b := by
  unfold campanatoBallValue
  apply mul_nonneg
  · exact Real.rpow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr b.radius_pos.le) α
  · exact integral_nonneg (fun x => abs_nonneg _)
def HasCampanatoBound (u : E → ℝ) (x₀ : E) (R α C : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ b : CampanatoBall x₀ R,
    IntegrableOn u (Metric.ball (CampanatoBall.center b) (CampanatoBall.radius b)) volume ∧
      campanatoBallValue u α b ≤ C

noncomputable def dyadicBallAverage (u : E → ℝ) (x : E) (ρ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ⨍ z in Metric.ball x (ρ / (2 : ℝ) ^ n), u z ∂volume

lemma HasCampanatoBound.integrableOn
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C : ℝ}
    (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C) (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) :
    IntegrableOn u (Metric.ball (CampanatoBall.center b) (CampanatoBall.radius b)) volume :=
  (hcamp b).1

lemma HasCampanatoBound.ballValue_le
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C : ℝ}
    (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C) (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) :
    campanatoBallValue u α b ≤ C :=
  (hcamp b).2

lemma HasCampanatoBound.campanatoSeminorm_le
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C : ℝ}
    (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C) (hR : 0 < R) :
    campanatoSeminorm u x₀ R α ≤ C := by
  unfold campanatoSeminorm
  apply csSup_le
  · exact ⟨_, ⟨⟨⟨x₀, R⟩, hR, le_refl R, Subset.refl _⟩, rfl⟩⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨b, rfl⟩
    exact hcamp.ballValue_le b

lemma HasCampanatoBound.nonneg
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C : ℝ}
    (_hα : 0 < α) (hR : 0 < R) (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C) :
    0 ≤ C := by
  have b₀ : CampanatoBall x₀ R := ⟨⟨x₀, R⟩, hR, le_refl R, Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_refl R)⟩
  exact le_trans (campanatoBallValue_nonneg b₀) (hcamp.ballValue_le b₀)
noncomputable def C_campanato_holder (d : ℕ) (α : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (2 : ℝ) ^ (d + 3) / (1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-α))

lemma closedBall_ae_eq_ball_of_pos (x : E) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    Metric.closedBall x r =ᵐ[volume] Metric.ball x r := by
  rw [ae_eq_set]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Metric.closedBall_diff_ball]
    exact Measure.addHaar_sphere_of_ne_zero volume x hr.ne'
  · rw [Set.diff_eq_empty.mpr Metric.ball_subset_closedBall]
    exact measure_empty

lemma setAverage_closedBall_eq_ball_of_pos
    {u : E → ℝ} (x : E) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    ⨍ z in Metric.closedBall x r, u z ∂volume = ⨍ z in Metric.ball x r, u z ∂volume := by
  congr 1
  exact Measure.restrict_congr_set (closedBall_ae_eq_ball_of_pos x hr)

lemma tendsto_dyadic_radius_nhdsWithin_zero {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ρ / (2 : ℝ) ^ n) atTop (𝓝[>] 0) := by
  rw [Filter.tendsto_inf]
  constructor
  · -- Tendsto to nhds 0
    rw [show (fun n : ℕ => ρ / (2 : ℝ) ^ n) = (fun n : ℕ => ρ * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n)) from by
      ext n; rw [div_eq_mul_inv, one_div, inv_pow]]
    rw [show (0 : ℝ) = ρ * 0 from by ring]
    exact Filter.Tendsto.const_mul
      (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num))
      (Or.inl rfl)
  · -- Tendsto to principal Ioi 0
    rw [Filter.tendsto_principal]
    apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro n
    exact div_pos hρ (pow_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2) n)

lemma ball_subset_ball_of_mem_ball_half
    {x₀ x : E} {R r : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (R / 2)) (_hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrR : r ≤ R / 2) :
    Metric.ball x r ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R := by
  intro y hy
  rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hx hy ⊢
  linarith [dist_triangle y x x₀]

lemma closedBall_subset_ball_of_mem_ball_half
    {x₀ x : E} {R r : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (R / 2)) (_hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrR : r ≤ R / 2) :
    Metric.closedBall x r ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R := by
  intro y hy
  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hy
  rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hx ⊢
  linarith [dist_triangle y x x₀]

lemma hasCampanatoBound_of_ballSubset
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C : ℝ}
    (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C)
    {x : E} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hrR : r ≤ R)
    (hsub : Metric.ball x r ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R) :
    IntegrableOn u (Metric.ball x r) volume ∧
      r⁻¹ ^ α *
          ⨍ z in Metric.ball x r,
            |u z - ⨍ w in Metric.ball x r, u w| ∂volume
        ≤ C := by
  have hb := hcamp (⟨⟨x, r⟩, hr, hrR, hsub⟩ : CampanatoBall x₀ R)
  simp only [CampanatoBall.center, CampanatoBall.radius, campanatoBallValue] at hb
  exact hb

lemma le_mul_rpow_of_inv_rpow_mul_le
    {a C r α : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (h : r⁻¹ ^ α * a ≤ C) :
    a ≤ C * r ^ α := by
  have hr_pow : (0 : ℝ) < r⁻¹ ^ α := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hr) α
  have key : a ≤ C * (r⁻¹ ^ α)⁻¹ := by
    rwa [← div_eq_mul_inv, le_div_iff₀ hr_pow, mul_comm]
  rwa [Real.inv_rpow hr.le, inv_inv] at key

lemma abs_ballAverage_half_sub_ballAverage_le
    {u : E → ℝ} {x : E} {r : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 < r)
    (hu_int : IntegrableOn u (Metric.ball x r) volume) :
    |⨍ z in Metric.ball x (r / 2), u z ∂volume - ⨍ z in Metric.ball x r, u z ∂volume|
      ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ d *
        ⨍ z in Metric.ball x r, |u z - ⨍ w in Metric.ball x r, u w| ∂volume := by sorry

lemma abs_halfSubballAverage_sub_ballAverage_le
    {u : E → ℝ} {x c : E} {r : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 < r)
    (hsub : Metric.ball c (r / 2) ⊆ Metric.ball x r)
    (hu_int : IntegrableOn u (Metric.ball x r) volume) :
    |⨍ z in Metric.ball c (r / 2), u z ∂volume - ⨍ z in Metric.ball x r, u z ∂volume|
      ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ d *
        ⨍ z in Metric.ball x r, |u z - ⨍ w in Metric.ball x r, u w| ∂volume := by sorry

lemma ballAverage_sub_ballAverage_sameRadius_le_campanato
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C : ℝ}
    (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C)
    {x y : E} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hrR : r ≤ R) (hxy : dist x y ≤ r)
    (hxsub : Metric.ball x r ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R)
    (hysub : Metric.ball y r ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R) :
    |⨍ z in Metric.ball x r, u z ∂volume - ⨍ z in Metric.ball y r, u z ∂volume|
      ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (d + 1) * C * r ^ α := by sorry

lemma dyadicBallAverage_step_le_campanato
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ x : E} {R α C ρ : ℝ}
    (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C)
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρR : ρ ≤ R) (hsub : Metric.ball x ρ ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R)
    (n : ℕ) :
    |dyadicBallAverage u x ρ n - dyadicBallAverage u x ρ (n + 1)|
      ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ d * C * (ρ / (2 : ℝ) ^ n) ^ α := by sorry

lemma dyadicBallAverage_step_le_geometric
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ x : E} {R α C ρ : ℝ}
    (_hα : 0 < α)
    (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C)
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρR : ρ ≤ R) (hsub : Metric.ball x ρ ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R)
    (n : ℕ) :
    dist (dyadicBallAverage u x ρ n) (dyadicBallAverage u x ρ (n + 1))
      ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ d * C * ρ ^ α) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (-α)) ^ n := by sorry

lemma dyadicBallAverage_cauchy
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ x : E} {R α C ρ : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < α)
    (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C)
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρR : ρ ≤ R) (hsub : Metric.ball x ρ ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R) :
    CauchySeq (dyadicBallAverage u x ρ) := by sorry

noncomputable def dyadicBallAverageLimit
    (u : E → ℝ) (x : E) (ρ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  limUnder atTop (dyadicBallAverage u x ρ)

lemma tendsto_dyadicBallAverageLimit
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ x : E} {R α C ρ : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < α)
    (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C)
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρR : ρ ≤ R) (hsub : Metric.ball x ρ ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R) :
    Tendsto (dyadicBallAverage u x ρ) atTop (𝓝 (dyadicBallAverageLimit u x ρ)) := by sorry

    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ x : E} {R α C ρ : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < α)
    (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C)
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρR : ρ ≤ R) (hsub : Metric.ball x ρ ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R)
    (n : ℕ) :

      ≤ (((2 : ℝ) ^ d * C * ρ ^ α) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (-α)) ^ n) / (1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-α)) := by sorry

lemma abs_halfSubballAverage_sub_ballAverage_le_campanato
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C : ℝ}
    (hR : 0 < R) (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C)
    {c : E} (hsub : Metric.ball c (R / 2) ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R) :
    |⨍ z in Metric.ball c (R / 2), u z ∂volume - ⨍ z in Metric.ball x₀ R, u z ∂volume|
      ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ d * C * R ^ α := by sorry

lemma ballAverage_half_sub_ballAverage_le_campanato
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C : ℝ}
    (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C)
    {x : E} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hrR : r ≤ R)
    (hsub : Metric.ball x r ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R) :
    |⨍ z in Metric.ball x (r / 2), u z ∂volume - ⨍ z in Metric.ball x r, u z ∂volume|

lemma ae_eq_dyadicBallAverageLimit_on_halfBall
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C_camp : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < α) (hR : 0 < R)
    (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C_camp) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂volume.restrict (Metric.ball x₀ (R / 2)),
      dyadicBallAverageLimit u x (R / 2) = u x := by sorry

lemma dyadicBallAverageLimit_holder_small
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C_camp : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < α) (hα_le : α ≤ 1) (hR : 0 < R)
    (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C_camp)
    {x y : E}
    (hx : x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (R / 2))
    (hy : y ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (R / 2))
    (hsmall : ‖x - y‖ ≤ R / 2) :
    |dyadicBallAverageLimit u x (R / 2) - dyadicBallAverageLimit u y (R / 2)|
      ≤ C_campanato_holder d α * C_camp * ‖x - y‖ ^ α := by sorry

lemma dyadicBallAverageLimit_holder_large
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C_camp : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < α) (hα_le : α ≤ 1) (hR : 0 < R)
    (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C_camp)
    {x y : E}
    (hx : x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (R / 2))
    (hy : y ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (R / 2))
    (hlarge : R / 2 ≤ ‖x - y‖) :
    |dyadicBallAverageLimit u x (R / 2) - dyadicBallAverageLimit u y (R / 2)|
      ≤ C_campanato_holder d α * C_camp * ‖x - y‖ ^ α := by sorry
theorem campanato_implies_holder
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C_camp : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < α) (hα_le : α ≤ 1) (hR : 0 < R)
    (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C_camp) :
    ∃ v : E → ℝ,
      (∀ᵐ x ∂volume.restrict (Metric.ball x₀ R), v x = u x) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (R / 2), ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (R / 2),
        |v x - v y| ≤ C_campanato_holder d α * C_camp * ‖x - y‖ ^ α := by sorry

lemma holder_hasCampanatoBound
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C_hold : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < α) (hC_hold : 0 ≤ C_hold)
    (hhold : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ R, ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x₀ R,
      |u x - u y| ≤ C_hold * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) :
    HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α (C_hold * (2 : ℝ) ^ α) := by sorry
theorem holder_implies_campanato
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C_hold : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < α) (hR : 0 < R) (hC_hold : 0 ≤ C_hold)
    (hhold : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ R, ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x₀ R,
      |u x - u y| ≤ C_hold * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) :
    campanatoSeminorm u x₀ R α ≤ C_hold * (2 : ℝ) ^ α := by sorry

end DeGiorgi

import DeGiorgi.Oscillation.BMO

/-!
# Chapter 02: Campanato and Holder Theory

This module packages the Campanato seminorm machinery and the equivalence with
Holder regularity.
-/

noncomputable section

open MeasureTheory Metric Filter Set
open scoped ENNReal NNReal Topology

namespace DeGiorgi

variable {d : ℕ}

local notation "E" => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)

/-! ## Campanato Characterization of Hölder Spaces -/

/-- Admissible sub-balls of `Metric.ball x₀ R` for the Campanato seminorm. -/
def CampanatoBall (x₀ : E) (R : ℝ) :=
  {p : E × ℝ // 0 < p.2 ∧ p.2 ≤ R ∧ Metric.ball p.1 p.2 ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R}

namespace CampanatoBall

def center {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) : E := b.1.1

def radius {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) : ℝ := b.1.2

lemma radius_pos {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) : 0 < b.radius := b.2.1

lemma radius_le {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) : b.radius ≤ R := b.2.2.1

lemma subset_ball {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) :
    Metric.ball b.center b.radius ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R := b.2.2.2

end CampanatoBall

/-- The Campanato seminorm on a ball B_R(x₀):
sup_{B ⊆ B_R} ⨍_B |u - (u)_B|. -/
noncomputable def campanatoBallValue
    (u : E → ℝ) (α : ℝ) {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) : ℝ :=
  (CampanatoBall.radius b)⁻¹ ^ α *
    ⨍ x in Metric.ball (CampanatoBall.center b) (CampanatoBall.radius b),
      |u x - ⨍ z in Metric.ball (CampanatoBall.center b) (CampanatoBall.radius b), u z| ∂volume

noncomputable def campanatoSeminorm (u : E → ℝ) (x₀ : E) (R : ℝ) (α : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sSup (Set.range (campanatoBallValue u α (x₀ := x₀) (R := R)))

lemma campanatoBallValue_nonneg
    {u : E → ℝ} {α : ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) :
    0 ≤ campanatoBallValue u α b := by
  unfold campanatoBallValue
  apply mul_nonneg
  · exact Real.rpow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr b.radius_pos.le) α
  · exact integral_nonneg (fun x => abs_nonneg _)
def HasCampanatoBound (u : E → ℝ) (x₀ : E) (R α C : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ b : CampanatoBall x₀ R,
    IntegrableOn u (Metric.ball (CampanatoBall.center b) (CampanatoBall.radius b)) volume ∧
      campanatoBallValue u α b ≤ C

noncomputable def dyadicBallAverage (u : E → ℝ) (x : E) (ρ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ⨍ z in Metric.ball x (ρ / (2 : ℝ) ^ n), u z ∂volume

lemma HasCampanatoBound.integrableOn
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C : ℝ}
    (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C) (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) :
    IntegrableOn u (Metric.ball (CampanatoBall.center b) (CampanatoBall.radius b)) volume :=
  (hcamp b).1

lemma HasCampanatoBound.ballValue_le
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C : ℝ}
    (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C) (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) :
    campanatoBallValue u α b ≤ C :=
  (hcamp b).2

lemma HasCampanatoBound.campanatoSeminorm_le
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C : ℝ}
    (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C) (hR : 0 < R) :
    campanatoSeminorm u x₀ R α ≤ C := by
  unfold campanatoSeminorm
  apply csSup_le
  · exact ⟨_, ⟨⟨⟨x₀, R⟩, hR, le_refl R, Subset.refl _⟩, rfl⟩⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨b, rfl⟩
    exact hcamp.ballValue_le b

lemma HasCampanatoBound.nonneg
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C : ℝ}
    (_hα : 0 < α) (hR : 0 < R) (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C) :
    0 ≤ C := by
  have b₀ : CampanatoBall x₀ R := ⟨⟨x₀, R⟩, hR, le_refl R, Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_refl R)⟩
  exact le_trans (campanatoBallValue_nonneg b₀) (hcamp.ballValue_le b₀)
noncomputable def C_campanato_holder (d : ℕ) (α : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (2 : ℝ) ^ (d + 3) / (1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-α))

lemma closedBall_ae_eq_ball_of_pos (x : E) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    Metric.closedBall x r =ᵐ[volume] Metric.ball x r := by
  rw [ae_eq_set]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Metric.closedBall_diff_ball]
    exact Measure.addHaar_sphere_of_ne_zero volume x hr.ne'
  · rw [Set.diff_eq_empty.mpr Metric.ball_subset_closedBall]
    exact measure_empty

lemma setAverage_closedBall_eq_ball_of_pos
    {u : E → ℝ} (x : E) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    ⨍ z in Metric.closedBall x r, u z ∂volume = ⨍ z in Metric.ball x r, u z ∂volume := by
  congr 1
  exact Measure.restrict_congr_set (closedBall_ae_eq_ball_of_pos x hr)

lemma tendsto_dyadic_radius_nhdsWithin_zero {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ρ / (2 : ℝ) ^ n) atTop (𝓝[>] 0) := by
  rw [nhdsWithin, Filter.tendsto_inf]
  constructor
  · -- Tendsto to nhds 0
    have : (fun n : ℕ => ρ / (2 : ℝ) ^ n) = (fun n : ℕ => ρ * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n)) := by
      ext n; rw [div_eq_mul_inv, one_div, inv_pow]
    rw [this, show (0 : ℝ) = ρ * 0 from by ring]
    exact Filter.Tendsto.const_mul
      (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num))
      (Or.inl rfl)
  · -- Tendsto to principal Ioi 0
    rw [Filter.tendsto_principal]
    apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro n
    exact div_pos hρ (pow_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2) n)

lemma ball_subset_ball_of_mem_ball_half
    {x₀ x : E} {R r : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (R / 2)) (_hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrR : r ≤ R / 2) :
    Metric.ball x r ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R := by
  intro y hy
  rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hx hy ⊢
  linarith [dist_triangle y x x₀]

lemma closedBall_subset_ball_of_mem_ball_half
    {x₀ x : E} {R r : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (R / 2)) (_hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrR : r ≤ R / 2) :
    Metric.closedBall x r ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R := by
  intro y hy
  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hy
  rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hx ⊢
  linarith [dist_triangle y x x₀]

lemma hasCampanatoBound_of_ballSubset
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C : ℝ}
    (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C)
    {x : E} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hrR : r ≤ R)
    (hsub : Metric.ball x r ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R) :
    IntegrableOn u (Metric.ball x r) volume ∧
      r⁻¹ ^ α *
          ⨍ z in Metric.ball x r,
            |u z - ⨍ w in Metric.ball x r, u w| ∂volume
        ≤ C := by
  have hb := hcamp (⟨⟨x, r⟩, hr, hrR, hsub⟩ : CampanatoBall x₀ R)
  simp only [CampanatoBall.center, CampanatoBall.radius, campanatoBallValue] at hb
  exact hb

lemma le_mul_rpow_of_inv_rpow_mul_le
    {a C r α : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (h : r⁻¹ ^ α * a ≤ C) :
    a ≤ C * r ^ α := by
  have hr_pow : (0 : ℝ) < r⁻¹ ^ α := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hr) α
  have key : a ≤ C * (r⁻¹ ^ α)⁻¹ := by
    rwa [← div_eq_mul_inv, le_div_iff₀ hr_pow, mul_comm]
  rwa [Real.inv_rpow hr.le, inv_inv] at key

lemma abs_ballAverage_half_sub_ballAverage_le
    {u : E → ℝ} {x : E} {r : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 < r)
    (hu_int : IntegrableOn u (Metric.ball x r) volume) :
    |⨍ z in Metric.ball x (r / 2), u z ∂volume - ⨍ z in Metric.ball x r, u z ∂volume|
      ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ d *
        ⨍ z in Metric.ball x r, |u z - ⨍ w in Metric.ball x r, u w| ∂volume := by sorry

lemma abs_halfSubballAverage_sub_ballAverage_le
    {u : E → ℝ} {x c : E} {r : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 < r)
    (hsub : Metric.ball c (r / 2) ⊆ Metric.ball x r)
    (hu_int : IntegrableOn u (Metric.ball x r) volume) :

      ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ d *

import DeGiorgi.ScaledBallEstimates
import DeGiorgi.WeakHarnack

/-!
# Support: Iteration Constants

Shared numerical constants and elementary positivity lemmas for the Harnack and
Moser Holder endpoint files.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace DeGiorgi

/-- The local Moser base constant appearing in the Chapter 07 endpoint bounds. -/
noncomputable def localMoserBase (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] : ℝ :=
  C_Moser d * (((d : ℝ) - 1) ^ (d : ℝ)) * ((4 : ℝ) ^ (d : ℝ))

/-- The local weak Harnack base constant appearing in the Chapter 07 endpoint
bounds. -/
noncomputable def localWeakHarnackBase (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] : ℝ :=
  C_weakHarnack_of d * ((d : ℝ) ^ (weak_harnack_decay_exp d))

theorem localMoserBase_nonneg (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] : 0 ≤ localMoserBase d := by
  unfold localMoserBase
  apply mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (le_trans zero_le_one one_le_C_Moser) _) _
  · exact Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (d : ℝ) - 1) _
  · exact Real.rpow_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4) _

theorem localMoserBase_pos (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] (hd : 2 < (d : ℝ)) :
    0 < localMoserBase d := by
  unfold localMoserBase
  apply mul_pos (mul_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one one_le_C_Moser) _) _
  · exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < (d : ℝ) - 1) _
  · exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 4) _

theorem localWeakHarnackBase_pos (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] :
    0 < localWeakHarnackBase d := by sorry

theorem one_le_localMoserBase (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] (hd : 2 < (d : ℝ)) :
    1 ≤ localMoserBase d := by
  unfold localMoserBase
  have hd_pos : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (d : ℝ) := by positivity
  calc (1 : ℝ) ≤ C_Moser d := one_le_C_Moser
    _ = C_Moser d * 1 * 1 := by ring
    _ ≤ C_Moser d * ((d : ℝ) - 1) ^ (d : ℝ) * (4 : ℝ) ^ (d : ℝ) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (le_trans zero_le_one one_le_C_Moser)
        apply mul_le_mul
        · exact Real.one_le_rpow (by linarith : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (d : ℝ) - 1) hd_pos
        · exact Real.one_le_rpow (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (4 : ℝ)) hd_pos
        · exact zero_le_one
        · exact le_trans zero_le_one (Real.one_le_rpow (by linarith) hd_pos)

theorem one_le_localWeakHarnackBase (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] (hd : 2 < (d : ℝ)) :
    1 ≤ localWeakHarnackBase d := by sorry

end DeGiorgi
